purpose: Top-level authority map for the microscope-slide repository. This file identifies the current state of each evidence/publication layer while preserving older versioned files as audit history.

survey.rule: Never extend frozen membership silently; modular survey batches remain an audit trail.

bibliography.legacy_note: The static bibliography.csv is a predecessor partial index and is not the current 206-row authority. Use the manifest/chunks or the bibliography page exports.

corpus.rule: Corpus registries and BNA compact tables are publication/navigation derivatives and do not override canonical source masters.

source_registry.rule: Source-registry entries describe documentary routes and holdings; they are not object-census rows and are not nineteenth-century corpus text by default.

evidence.rule: Harvest evidence enriches frozen nodes and cannot reopen census membership.

website.rule: Pages cards and labels never override survey, source, or analysis authority.

supersession_policy.rule: Older dated/versioned research files remain as audit history. Current authority is resolved through this manifest and layer-specific CURRENT/manifest files, not by filename recency alone.

quantity_invariants: serial numbers, catalogue numbers, accession numbers, slide counts, preparation counts and cabinet capacities remain distinct namespaces
